intent_en: Compare the U.S. vegan population share between the two years shown and report how the share changed across the full time span.
narration_support: As of Pulse taken in 2014, vegans now make up roughly 2.5% of the population, at least in the United States
chart_support: Infographic labels displaying vegan population percentages in the US for 2008 and 2014, indicating a rise over time.
evidence_note: Narration provides the 2014 data point and US context but cuts off before mentioning gender details; chart provides the 2008 baseline necessary to establish the growth trend, though it does not show the gender breakdown mentioned in the narration.
narrative_goal: Show that the U.S. vegan population share rose from 0.5% in 2008 to 2.5% in 2014.
current_model_input: Compare the U.S. vegan population share between the two years shown and report how the share changed across the full time span.
